messages:
sam (eng): Heads up, Alex from ChipCo flagged that their on-device meter can emit duplicate events when connectivity flaps. They want Redwood to support signed deltas and a dedicated hardware ingestion path. Thoughts?
alex (hw-partner): Yep, devices will occasionally resend the same delta with same sequence_number. We need idempotent ingestion and cryptographic signatures so we can prove origin during audits.
kevin (billing): We can accept `device_sequence_number` + `device_id` and dedupe server-side for 7 days. Are signature requirements HMAC-SHA256 with shared key acceptable?
sam (eng): HMAC is fine. We'll verify signature and store (device_id, seq_no) pairs in dedupe store (redis with TTL). For higher throughput, we can accept batched deltas compressed in ndjson.
maria (partnerships): Contractually, ChipCo asks for 99.9% acceptance for on-device uploads. We need to be careful: acceptance should mean HTTP 200 received and validated, not ledger written. Clarify in contract.
alex (hw-partner): Correct, acceptance = validated and queued. We'll then poll status_url for finalization. We also need explainability fields: firmware_version, region, and upload_retry_count.
kevin (billing): Billing needs tokens mapping for hardware meters. We'll require plan mapping in header `X-Partner-Plan-Id`. Also provide `X-Redwood-Event-Id` back.
sam (eng): Proposed API: POST /v1/partners/{id}/hw/deltas, support both single JSON and gzipped ndjson. Headers: `X-Partner-Idempotency-Key`, `X-Partner-Signature`, `X-Partner-Plan-Id`. Response: 202 with event_id and status_url. Example payload snippet: {"device_id":"chip-99","sequence_number": 1234, "timestamp":"2026-03-21T12:00:00Z", "units": 500}.
ops-bot: automated: upload-path created: hw-ingest-fastpath, metric `hw_ingest_rejected_signature` added.
kevin (billing): One more ask: for audit trails, store original payload in cold storage for 90 days with link in reconciliation CSV.
maria (partnerships): Okay, I'll add that to the appendix and push a redline to ChipCo. Also propose a pilot window (30 days) to iron out edgecases.
sam (eng): Implementation note: dedupe store TTL 7d, idempotency key TTL 48h, signature verification using partner-managed key rotated monthly.
alex (hw-partner): Sounds good. We'll try pilot next week. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
